title: Lack of Unique Diagnostic Codes
pattern: Emitting critical log strings that completely lack a unique, static alphanumeric code.
why_bad: Prevents precise communications between operators and developers, complicates automated log-scanning routing rules, and makes searching in runbooks difficult [284, 693].
detection: A static check that flags any error-level string lacking an identifier (e.g., `[ERR_FULFILL_02]`).
fix: Prepend unique error codes to critical system error messages.
